verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Plaid blog post describing a "verify once, verify everywhere" one-click verification experience for faster KYC-compliant onboarding (plaid-idv-docs-23). That signals intent to reuse prior verifications. The retry endpoint, RETRIED webhook and Dashboard override only cover re-running or overriding a session, not reusing a passed check. Missing for 10: developer documentation or API for recognizing a returning verified user, reuse of a prior passed check across sessions or products without a full re-run, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
